info.title: RoomCircuit
info.author: LANywhere contributors
info.description: Switch Local Wireless over the internet
info.details: RoomCircuit brings Switch Local Wireless online with room browsing, custom nodes, latency checks, and scheduling. Requires Atmosphère; it replaces the ldn_mitm module with the same ID. Restart after installation.\n\nSome code was generated with AI.

changelog: Add custom nodes, remember the selected server, and show server status in the overlay.
